name: Box Replacer
description: A 2-cell cover hides two boxes. Play matching color to chip the counter and spawn replacement boxes — at zero, the cover lifts off.
howToPlay: Tap a Pink box. The Replacer's counter ticks down and a new Pink box appears somewhere. Play 3 Pinks to clear the Replacer and reveal the Purple + Orange boxes underneath.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Replacer — First Look
showcaseLevel.desc: Tap pink boxes to chip the cover. At 0, the boxes underneath are revealed.
